needs.description: Complete dry kibble formulated for growing/active young dogs (7 months), calorically appropriate for a 40 lb, high-activity male pug. Size/formula: adult-transition or large-breed puppy-to-adult formula with balanced protein/fat (moderate calorie density to avoid excess weight), kibble size small-to-medium for brachycephalic muzzle. Ensure ingredient list excludes duck protein. Preference: Mars-owned formulas acceptable (user bias). Size: 15–30 lb bag.
needs.rationale: Daily primary nutrition — AJ needs a reliable daily kibble formulated for growth and high activity. As a 7-month-old pug at 40 lb, feeding an appropriate kibble every day is essential for growth, energy and weight management. Must avoid duck due to allergy.

needs.description: Small, soft, easily breakable training treats for frequent reward-based training (pea-sized pieces). Low-calorie formula for repeated use; meat/protein source must NOT be duck. Pack size: small bags (3–6 oz) or resealable pouches for freshness. Texture: soft/moist to be eaten quickly during training.
needs.rationale: At 7 months AJ is still in intensive training/socialization. Frequent small rewards are used daily to reinforce good behavior. Soft low-calorie treats reduce calorie load while enabling many repetitions. Avoid duck due to allergy.

needs.description: Heavy-duty stainless steel, non-tip (rubber base), wide-mouth water bowl sized for medium/large dogs (capacity ~48–64 oz) for daily home use. Dishwasher-safe, rust-resistant. Stable base to prevent spills in apartment environment.
needs.rationale: Daily water is essential. A sturdy non-tip steel bowl ensures AJ has fresh water every day and reduces spills in an apartment. Steel is hygienic and durable for a heavy, active dog.

needs.family: Collapsible travel water bottle with attached bowl
needs.description: Portable, leak-proof travel water bottle that folds out into an attached bowl/cup for drinking; capacity about 20–28 oz. Lightweight, easy-clean, with a carabiner for clips to leash. Useful for walks and yard visits.
needs.rationale: Excessive heat warning + AJ's brachycephalic breed increase heat-risk during outings. Having on-walk hydration available immediately prevents dehydration and heat emergency — essential when leaving the apartment or using the yard.

needs.description: Lightweight, evaporative/ice-pack compatible cooling vest or jacket sized to a compact, short-legged brachycephalic body shape (adjustable straps, reflective trim). Designed for use during walks and outdoor activity to lower body temp rapidly. Machine-washable materials.
needs.rationale: Pugs are highly heat-sensitive (brachycephalic). With an active dog and an excessive heat warning, a cooling vest for walks is an immediate safety item to reduce risk of heat stress during outdoor exercise.

needs.description: Single-item: extremely durable chew toy constructed from tough rubber or nylon sized for strong chewers (non-toxic, low-fragmentation). Designed for aggressive chewing and long use—shaped for treat insertion or solo chewing. Avoid edible chews with duck ingredients.
needs.rationale: AJ is a strong chewer and energetic—without durable chew options he may destroy household items and ingest hazardous materials. A robust chew toy reduces immediate safety hazards and provides daily outlet for chewing behavior.
evidence: pet_characteristic: about: AJ is very energetic and very strong.

needs.description: Undercoat rake or de-shedding tool sized for short-coated breeds with firm bristles and ergonomic handle. Helps capture seasonal loose hair. Washable/replaceable head recommended.
needs.rationale: Fall shedding season is active and pugs shed significantly. Regular deshedding reduces hair in the apartment and reduces allergen load for the household; timely grooming prevents matting and skin irritation.

needs.description: Fragrance-free, hypoallergenic pet grooming wipes formulated for sensitive skin and to remove pollen/dust. Individually wrapped or packet of wipes for quick cleanups after yard/play. Alcohol-free, pH-balanced.
needs.rationale: Allergy season is active and AJ is in a region with fall allergens. Wipes help remove allergens from coat/paws after outdoor time and reduce sneezing/itching, supporting comfort and preventing secondary skin problems.
evidence: calendar_context: event: Allergy Season (Fall Allergy Season)

needs.description: Dog-specific toothbrush (finger or dual-head) and enzymatic toothpaste safe for ingestion; flavored for palatability (non-duck flavors). Travel-size kit for home daily brushing.
needs.rationale: Dental care is recommended to begin around 6–8 months. Regular brushing reduces plaque buildup and future dental disease. As AJ is approaching adulthood, starting daily/regular brushing now is preventive care.

needs.description: Slow-feeder / maze bowl designed to slow eating (plastic or ceramic, dishwasher-safe) sized for mid-size mouths. Reduces gulping and helps digestion; low-profile for brachycephalic head shape.
needs.rationale: Pugs can gulp quickly which increases risk of digestive upset. A slow feeder reduces rapid eating, lowering bloat/aspiration/regurgitation risk and improving mealtime behavior.

needs.description: Adjustable front-clip no-pull harness built to withstand strong pullers, with padded chest panel for brachycephalic chest shape and reflective trim for low-light safety. Durable buckles and multiple sizing options for compact body type.
needs.rationale: AJ is very strong and active; a no-pull harness reduces leash-pulling and improves safety on walks. Reflective trim helps during low-light walks (hunting season & early mornings).

needs.family: LED clip-on safety light or reflective collar band
needs.description: Rechargeable LED clip-on light or reflective collar band for nighttime/low-visibility walks. Lightweight and easily attachable to collar/harness; multiple modes (steady, blink).
needs.rationale: Hunting season and variable daylight, plus apartment neighborhood walks, increase risk during low-light hours. Visibility gear reduces risk of accidents and improves owner confidence on outdoor trips.

needs.family: Cooling mat (indoor gel or self-cooling pad)
needs.description: Passive cooling mat (gel or phase-change) sized for a medium dog to lie on inside the apartment. Non-electric, pressure-activated or gel-based, with washable cover.
needs.rationale: With excessive heat periods, an indoor cooling surface helps AJ regulate body temp while resting inside and reduces heat stress between outdoor activities.

needs.family: Paw wax or protective dog boots
needs.description: Paw protection option: either a tub of paw balm (wax-based) for conditioning and minor protection, or lightweight protective dog boots sized for small/medium paws. Boots should have non-slip soles for apartment floors and outdoor protection on hot pavement.
needs.rationale: During heat alerts, pavement and outdoor surfaces can become too hot for paw pads. Paw wax or boots are preventive to avoid burns and soreness during walks or yard play.

needs.description: 20–30 ft lightweight training lead with swivel clip for recall training in a large yard. Durable webbing, reflective stitching, and comfortable hand loop.
needs.rationale: AJ has access to a large yard. A long training line supports safe off-leash recall practice without full freedom, aiding obedience and burn-off of energy while preventing runaways or hazards.

needs.description: Puppy/teething chew toys that are gentler than indestructible chews: textured rubber or woven rope styles to massage gums. Durable but slightly softer for teething puppies. Avoid edible/clear duck-sourced chews.
needs.rationale: At 7 months AJ may still be finishing the teething process. Teething toys reduce discomfort and destructive chewing while complementing the heavy-duty chew toy recommended as essential.

needs.description: Durable treat-dispensing puzzle that hides small kibble pieces or treats to encourage problem-solving. Adjustable difficulty levels recommended for progressive engagement.
needs.rationale: As a high-energy, intelligent young dog, AJ benefits from mental stimulation to reduce boredom and destructive behaviors, especially while indoors in an apartment or during rainy days.

needs.description: Durable flirt pole (pole with strong cord and secure lure) sized for apartment storage but used in yard/play areas to provide sprint and chase exercise. Replaceable lure and secure handle.
needs.rationale: AJ is very energetic; a flirt pole provides high-intensity bursts of exercise safely in yard or open areas, burning energy and improving impulse control when indoor/outdoor time is limited.

needs.description: High-bounce, durable rubber ball sized for medium mouths (not a choking hazard) made for aggressive players; non-toxic and floatable for water play in yard.
needs.rationale: Provides repetitive running/retrieval to expend energy. Durable construction is needed for AJ's strong jaws to avoid toy breakage and ingestion risk.

needs.description: Fabric snuffle mat for hiding kibble/treats to encourage foraging and scent work; machine-washable and sized for apartment floors.
needs.rationale: Nosework is mentally tiring and rewarding; the snuffle mat slows feeding and provides enrichment when outside activity is limited by weather or heat alerts.

needs.family: Silicone frozen treat molds (for homemade dog treats)
needs.description: Food-grade silicone molds to make frozen yogurt/kibble treats; multiple-cavity tray for portion control. Dishwasher-safe and freezer-safe.
needs.rationale: Frozen treats help cool AJ on hot days, provide enrichment, and can be used to slow feeding and reward. Useful during heat warnings as a safe cooling snack.

needs.description: Durable, reinforced tug rope sized for medium/large mouths; built for two-person interactive play. Knotted ends and chew-safe fibers.
needs.rationale: Interactive tug supports bonding, outlet for high energy, and controlled play sessions which are important for a strong, energetic young dog living in an apartment with yard access.
evidence: pet_characteristic: about: AJ is very energetic and very strong.

needs.description: Soft, machine-washable blanket sized for a medium dog bed, designed to hold owner scent and provide comfort in crate or sleeping area.
needs.rationale: Apartment living and changes in routine (school-year schedule) can cause mild stress; a comfort blanket provides security and reduces separation anxiety during alone time.

needs.family: Rotation pack of chew toys (set of 3–5 different textures)
needs.description: Assorted chew toy set including rubber, nylon, and braided textures to rotate availability; each toy sized appropriately to prevent swallowing and made from non-toxic materials. Avoid edible chews containing duck.
needs.rationale: Rotating different chew textures keeps AJ engaged and prevents boredom and over-attachment to a single toy. Variety supports dental and behavioral enrichment.

needs.family: Dog pheromone plug-in diffuser or collar (non-medicated calming)
needs.description: Adaptil-style synthetic pheromone diffuser or collar (non-medicated) to reduce noise/anxiety reactions (available as plug-in or collar form). Use in the apartment area where AJ rests. Not a medication.
needs.rationale: Hunting season and leaf blower noise windows are stress-inducing in the calendar context. A pheromone product can reduce noise-related anxiety episodes and make AJ more comfortable at home.

needs.family: Interactive treat-dispensing snuffle/hide board (small tabletop puzzle)
needs.description: Small interactive hide-board or puzzle board that requires paw/nose manipulation to reveal kibble; compact for apartment storage and easy to reset.
needs.rationale: Provides short-session puzzle play indoors during rainy days or heat-limited periods; useful for mental stimulation and slow feeding.
